name: Mama Haha wa Musuko o Aishiteru! 2 ~Mama ga Zenbu Oshiete Ageru♪ Yuuna Mama no Amayakashi Shasei Seikatsu~
original_name: ママハハは息子を愛してる！２ ～ママがぜーんぶ教えてあげる♪優奈ママの甘やかし射精性活～
source:
Nonoshita Yuuna and Tomoki live in a single-mother household. Though they are stepmother and stepchild, they are close like a normal family. Despite having their share of difficulties, they lead a happy life.

However, the son has a problem... Perhaps because he is in his puberty, he frequently has wet dreams.

Eventually, his mother notices, and the two of them try to do something about it...

[Translated from the [url=http://www.hs-crowd.co.jp/anim/product/pro_pc/pc087/index.html#story]official site[/url]]
translation:
野下优奈和智树生活在单亲家庭中。虽然他们是继母和继子，但他们就像一个正常的家庭一样亲密。尽管有一些困难，但他们过着幸福的生活。

然而，儿子有一个问题……也许是因为正处于青春期，所以经常梦遗。

最终，他的母亲注意到了，两人试图为此做点什么……

[翻译自[url=http://www.hs-crowd.co.jp/anim/product/pro_pc/pc087/index.html#story]官方网站[/url]]
